summary: Open-weights release: Apache 2.0 license added, HF download/hardware section, ~20 new benchmark rows incl. HoneyBench safety row, many scores filled or revised.
safety_implication: Safety table gains HoneyBench and fuller FORTRESS/StrongREJECT comparisons; new conclusion asserts no material uplift beyond existing open-weight models, justifying open release.
notable: The card quietly shifted from API-only to open weights (Apache 2.0) with a one-sentence open-release safety justification, while several previously published scores (DesignArena, Sudo L7, MathVision, FrontierCode) changed without any correction note.
